title: Dataset of Kantorovich-Rubinstein-Wasserstein Polytopes of Metric Spaces on up to 6 Points
question: How do exact polytope properties vary across metric instances and dimensions?
publisher: Delucchi, Emanuele (University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland); Kühne, Lukas (Bielefeld University); Mühlherr, Leonie (Bielefeld University); Rambau, Jörg (University of Bayreuth)
measurement_dates: Computational release April 2026; no measurement date applies.
variables_and_units: exact combinatorial objects, triangulations and computation results
validation_design: metric/polytope instances and dimension Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Exact computational objects, TOPCOM outputs, Julia/OSCAR files and notebook/PDF; largest dimension-six archive excluded because it expands beyond 500 MB.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Use exact verification/counterexamples by independent instances, not statistical row sampling. Scripts are source context, not executed during acquisition.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
